payload.title: Preserve bounded diagnosis results across authority publication retries
payload.description:
As an optimization operator, I want each bounded semantic diagnosis result durably published or safely retried, so that one authority-publication interruption does not silently prevent an otherwise valid portfolio decision.

Feature: Durable semantic diagnosis publication

Scenario: One diagnosis result cannot publish its authority evidence
  Given a bounded portfolio diagnosis call has returned
  When its immutable authority evidence cannot be committed
  Then the diagnosis remains visibly incomplete and non-executable
  And retry resumes the same deterministic diagnosis attempt without duplicate model contact
  And completed sibling diagnoses remain usable

Scenario: Retry succeeds
  Given the original model outcome is durably recoverable
  When authority publication is retried
  Then the same outcome is committed exactly once
  And portfolio selection may continue using complete evidence
